- Trial of stronger analgesia than ibuprofen, e.g., paracetamol regularly with food (dose/route/frequency not documented)  
- Continue hydration and rest  
- Monitor symptoms; advise to seek urgent care if worsening headache, new neurological symptoms, fever, rash, vomiting, or neck stiffness occur  
- Follow-up arranged if headache persists or worsens within 1-2 days
